paragraphs: (A town in the territory of Asher, Joshua 19:25.) Rabbi Yonatan ben Chali: Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin, chapter 6, halakhah 5.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Masoretic Joshua 19:25 verse includes Chali. The whole Guggenheimer Sanhedrin 6:5 paragraph fully names Rabbi Yonatan ben Chali. The town parenthesis and the personal-name pointer remain separate; this comparison establishes no geographical or genealogical identity.
